# Align SelectField themes and its trigger with ComboBox

Please comment to claim before starting and check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

The styling mismatch was reported from the **Resource** field in the Scheduler’s **Edit event** dialog. Reproduce in `examples/scheduler/basic/index.html` by double-clicking a booking, then opening the Resource choice. The standalone comparison is `examples/form/field/select/index.html`.

## The Problem

A Chromium check on the actual Scheduler dialog confirmed the mismatch in both Neo themes. Neo Dark paints Resource with `#303030` fill, `#777` border and `#eee` text. Its neighboring Title input uses `#11141c`, `#253974` and white. In Neo Light the Resource border is `#bbb` beside Title’s `#ddd`. The Resource arrow has no themed trigger segment, and the customizable picker opened with a white surface and black text in both themes.

## The Architectural Reality

- [`Neo.form.field.Select`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/form/field/Select.mjs) renders a real `<select>`. [EventEditor](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs) uses it for Resource. The Board card editor also consumes this field.
- [Select styling](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/resources/css/src/form/field/Select.css) owns the field chrome and enables customizable appearance for the opted-in path. It sets the picker’s appearance and leaves its surface and arrow to the browser.
- The [shared field-trigger styling](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/resources/css/src/form/field/trigger/Base.css) gives ComboBox its trigger segment, divider and token-driven states. Use that as the visual reference, with theme values available to standalone SelectField too. The native-select behavior and fallback contract come from #6136.

## The Fix

Style SelectField at the engine field layer. Align the closed control’s surface, text, border and state colors with the shared form-field palette. In the customizable mode, theme the open picker and make its trigger match the ComboBox chevron, alignment and divider. Use a glyph that renders in standalone examples without an icon font.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] SelectField’s closed control looks coherent alongside the other fields in Scheduler’s editor and in the standalone example. Check all five shipped themes, including normal, focus, invalid and disabled states.
- [ ] In the customizable browser path, the field has one visible ComboBox-style trigger and the open picker follows the active theme, including its text and selected option.
- [ ] Pointer and keyboard selection, the change event and typed values pass the existing `NativeSelectNL` coverage. Check the classic native fallback and its single visible arrow.
- [ ] The PR shows before/after frames from Scheduler **Edit event** in Neo Dark and Neo Light, with the closed Resource field and the open customizable picker.

## Out of Scope

EventEditor layout changes, replacing the field with ComboBox, and redesigning the platform’s classic option popup.

## Avoided Traps

Put the styling in SelectField’s shared CSS and theme values. Standalone SelectField may load a different CSS set from EventEditor, so verify the tokens and glyph there too.

Related: #6136. The prior Board contrast fix #21371 covered its Save label and selected outlines in two themes.

Open for contributor pickup. This is one bounded component styling repair with a public reproduction and existing native-field tests.

Latest open Engine issues, open and closed SelectField and native-select styling searches, and recent A2A claims checked on 21 November 2026. The separate Board card accent ticket #21741 owns card chrome and selection. The Knowledge Base led to #6136. No equivalent open issue or current claim surfaced.
